prompt:
EDIT the reference image(s). Keep this exact design identity — the silhouette language, colours, materials, lighting and 1-px near-black navy outline of:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen CELL VAULT terrain material swatch. Keep its colours, rock forms, strata and surface textures, translated from the painted swatch into the crisp pixel-art tileset described below: Retro 16-bit terrain tileset sheet for a horizontal arcade shooter, a regular grid of twenty equal square tiles in four rows of five with even gutters on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background, every tile drawn in the established CELL VAULT material (living green tissue of packed cells in a moss-to-jade ramp with pale nuclei and amber pores) at the same pixel scale, read left to right and top to bottom: three plain fill variants, a top surface edge with a soft membrane fold, a bottom ceiling edge, a left edge, a right edge, four outer corners, two inner corners, a 45-degree slope rising to the right, a 45-degree slope falling to the right, two destructible block variants with visible cracks, and two decor tiles. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel dark outline only on open edges, flat shading lit from the top-left, tiles meet seamlessly, no perspective, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.  Exactly five columns and four rows, twenty tiles, every cell filled. Every tile is a flat side-view square with no 3D cube tops or bevelled frames; the corner, inner-corner and slope tiles are real cut-out shapes whose empty part is the flat green key. Shade the tissue in dark moss and deep jade with dark navy outlines, clearly darker and bluer than the bright key green.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- FULL-BLEED OPAQUE painted panel: every pixel of the whole sheet is painted scenery, edge to edge — NO chroma key, NO border, NO frame, NO green anywhere.
- A CONTACT SHEET of exactly 24 (24) equal square cells forming a full 6-columns-by-4-rows grid EDGE TO EDGE — no gutters, no borders, no key background anywhere: cells touch each other on a one-cell grid. Each cell is one named CELL VAULT tile in this exact reading order: solid, floor, ceiling, wall-left, wall-right, slope-up, slope-down, slope-up-low, slope-up-high, slope-down-high, slope-down-low, ceil-slope-up, ceil-slope-down, ceil-slope-up-low, ceil-slope-up-high, ceil-slope-down-high, ceil-slope-down-low, brick, cube, tissue, tissue-live, calcified, nodule. Because the grid holds exactly 24 cells while the material names 23, cell 24 REPEATS the final tile (nodule) — a near-duplicate of cell 23. Every solid/floor/ceiling/wall tile is a full square flush to all four cell edges, filled wall to wall; every slope and edge tile keeps its clean diagonal or edge mask flush to the cell borders (the remainder shows the material's own darker backdrop, never green); decor tiles paint their whole cell. Bioluminescent green cellular tissue, calcified pale seams and dark chitin — the established CELL VAULT material. Flat 2D, no perspective, no 3D bevels.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 1152×768 px. Produce EXACTLY 24 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- The cells form ONE full-bleed contact grid edge to edge: no gutters, no key background between cells, but absolutely NO guide lines, NO drawn cell borders, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere (the tile names are ordering instructions only, never drawn).
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
